featured_reviews.name: Sanjay Pakhale
featured_reviews.review_text:
Avoid this dealer at all costs.
My experience with this showroom has been extremely disappointing and stressful. I purchased a vehicle here and later discovered serious mechanical problems, including petrol leakage from the carburetor and even a cracked chassis. These are not small issues — they indicate extremely poor maintenance and a complete lack of honesty during the sale.

When I approached the dealer about the problems, there was no proper support, no responsibility, and no respect shown. Instead of helping resolve the issue, they kept avoiding accountability and tried to blame everything on me. I have now been forced to file complaints because of their unprofessional and irresponsible behavior.

This dealer misleads customers, does not disclose the true condition of the vehicle, and shows zero concern for customer safety. Please be very careful before buying anything from this place. Check every document, verify the vehicle thoroughly, and don’t trust their words blindly.

I hope this review helps others avoid the trouble, mental stress, and financial loss I had to go through.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Today I completed the first service of my new Royal Enfield Classic 350, and I’m extremely satisfied with the overall experience. From start to finish, everything was handled very professionally and smoothly.

A special thanks to my service advisor, Mr. Ashish Yadav, who was very polite, knowledgeable, and supportive throughout the process. He patiently listened to all my concerns, explained every detail clearly, and ensured that all my doubts were addressed properly. He also took the time to walk me through the bike’s features, which was very helpful for me as a new owner.

The entire service team did a great job. They kept me regularly updated on the service status, so I never had to follow up or worry about the progress. Their communication and transparency were truly impressive.

One thing I really appreciated was the customer convenience—they arranged one staff member to drop me home, which shows their commitment to customer care. Additionally, the service charges were quite reasonable, making the experience even better.

Overall, it was a hassle-free and pleasant experience. I would definitely recommend this service center to other Royal Enfield owners. Great job by the entire team!

All were saying VSS Sensor defective. In order make this defect alright I have purchased two VSS Sensor through Maruti Suzuki spares but my problem was not resolved. Finally Mr. Melvin from Shine Auto has resolved this issue by identifying the exact fault that ECM was defective. He got it repaired through his sources and now my Speedo meter is working and showing both Speed as well km in the meter.

I appreciate the process of identifying the exact fault and giving the right solution in cost effective manner.
